# Full-Suite Baseline Classification

> The Awtsmoos renews every green proof and every old red scar in one present light; Awtsmoos.com distinguishes inherited debt from new regression so release truth stays bright.

## Current full-suite evidence

Command: `node --test test/*.test.mjs`

- Total tests: 519
- Passed: 500
- Failed: 19
- Current workspace job: `cmdjob_mtk3xqu4_0ac10f25184c`

## Baseline method

The exact original untouched repository commit `e5e4909d1c055795c77740a2ad37ff3250dd42d8` was checked out into an isolated detached worktree at:

`/Users/awtsmoos/.awtsmoos-worktrees/universal-baseline-e5e`

Every failing current test file existed at that baseline. The failing files were divided into four independent read-only lanes and executed without copying current source into the baseline.

## Lane A — cosmic feed

Baseline job: `cmdjob_mtk5urd0_5ac4d0cf737a`

Result: 8 tests, 3 pass, 5 fail.

The five failures reproduce the current red area:

- `cosmicFeedSceneContract.test.mjs`: missing cosmic-feed context module at tested repository-relative path.
- `cosmicNebulaShaderContract.test.mjs`: missing nebula pass at tested repository-relative path.
- `cosmicParticleShaderContract.test.mjs`: missing particle-field module at tested repository-relative path.
- `cosmicReferencePalette.test.mjs`: missing `geelooy/style/social/home/feed/tokens.css`.
- `cosmicSceneFrame.test.mjs`: `TypeError` reading `.update` from undefined.

## Lane B — botanical / creature / Nature capability registry

Baseline job: `cmdjob_mtk5v2wp_fe3051f19219`

Result: 6 tests, 3 pass, 3 fail.

The three failures reproduce the current red area:

- `botanicalGroundEvolution.test.mjs`: actual result includes `placements` beyond the expected key set.
- `creatureCompositionGraph.test.mjs`: expected attachment target path is absent and `.targets` is read from undefined.
- `natureCapabilityRegistry.test.mjs`: surface filtering exposes additional generation capabilities beyond the older expected two-item set.

## Lane C — particle / liquid / Blender / standard nodes / water

Baseline job: `cmdjob_mtk5vkx7_ab2a314555ac`

Result: 14 tests, 7 pass, 7 fail.

The seven failures reproduce the current red area:

- `proceduralObjectAdvancedParticleDynamics.test.mjs`: expected realtime-realism export is absent.
- `proceduralObjectOpenBlenderGraphIr.test.mjs`: material graph node ordering differs from the test expectation.
- `proceduralObjectPersistentLiquidRealism.test.mjs`: three subtests fail through `secondaryParticleBounds.js` reading index `0` from undefined bounds.
- `proceduralObjectStandardNodes.test.mjs`: expected standard-node predicate is false.
- `unifiedWaterSources.test.mjs`: continuous-source path reaches the same undefined secondary-particle bounds failure.

## Lane D — Procedural Portal / universal API

Baseline job: `cmdjob_mtk5y5sc_dbf42c16bf79`

Result: 7 tests, 3 pass, 4 fail.

The four failures reproduce the current red area:

- `proceduralPortalUniversalOperations.test.mjs`: current authority string is `native-specialist-or-federated` while the older assertion expects `native-specialist`.
- `proceduralPortalUniversalSession.test.mjs`: two subtests expect count `2` while actual is `1`.
- `universalApiCompositionCreators.test.mjs`: creator query returns `[]` rather than the expected two ids.

## Classification conclusion

The four untouched-baseline lanes account for exactly 5 + 3 + 7 + 4 = 19 failures, the same total as the current full-suite run and the same failing areas/signatures. Therefore the universal procedural API tranche introduced no newly discovered failing test in the 519-test package universe.

These 19 reds remain real technical debt, but they are inherited project debt rather than a release regression for this tranche. They must remain documented and must not be silently rewritten merely to manufacture an all-green package number.

## Release implication

The regression gate for this mission is considered satisfied when combined with the focused universal/default-compiler/support-state/constraint/cache/structural/demo-engine green evidence. The release can advance to browser proof, final readback/delta, exact-file Git integration, clean-worktree verification, push, activation, and public verification.
